owners.eventcentre: Durable per-player Event Centre root: recycle energy, desk/pet make jobs, admin conversion counters, notice-board offers/doing/history/award log and stored combat report ids
owners.bookskill: Building level/job state and the D509 level-1 materialization of extension building types 2/5/6/7
owners.i5: All scalar/stack balances, material debits, grants and overflow mail
owners.combat: Server-report encounter start/resolve/terminal and the report bytes
owners.characterhero: Owned hero table ids and per-hero displayed force
owners.playerroot: Canonical I4 player root rank 315 and academy progression level
owners.content: Versioned workshop/notice-board catalog and the event-centre policy revision

invariants: No foreign-owner SQL; typed ports and canonical observations
All mutations take actor fence, then player root 315, then the Event Centre root; the player root is the pair/ordering guard
1083 is the only read that advances due make/recycle/notice-board time; 1072/1074/1081/1090 are observations but recycle read projects regeneration without writing
Commit debit/grant/progress/receipt atomically; exact replay returns the stored reply before fresh catalog validation
Business refusals are HTTP 409 with error_code; unavailable is 503; malformed Event Centre params also refuse 409/error_code 1 so the stock callback never receives a 200 with a nested-shape error
Lists are bounded: 11 offers, 11 doing, 50 history, 11 award log, 5 partners, 100 history reads
D476: the notice-board source values are recorded, but no operator endpoint or validated overlay table ships before I11
Mentor state stays separate; no invented push routes

operator_tunables.d476_state: GAP: no validated Event Centre operator overlay table or endpoint is present before I11; the values below are the source/policy record only
operator_tunables.offer_selection: OWNED_HERO_ROWS_SORTED_BY_MISSION_ID_TO_TASK_LIMIT; event_centre_notice_board.task_limit; event_centre_notice_board.gold_task; tier minimum player levels 1/10/20
operator_tunables.eligibility: owned partner ids only; partner limit 5; busy heroes refused; team force at most event_centre_hero.upper_limit_fighting
operator_tunables.combat: SERVER_REPORT; campaign_type 96; event_centre_mission.enemy ids as TEMPLATE actors
operator_tunables.settlement: win grants the offer award, loss grants nothing and refunds any deposit; wish doubles every award line; blessing_crystal item 50001136; chest rows are granted as a stack item
operator_tunables.history: limit 50; reply.report[1].content is the stored JSON report string

clauses.title: Event Centre owner and lock order
clauses.rule: Every mutation fences the actor, locks the canonical I4 player root 315, then the event-centre root; board 1083 runs two serializable transactions because it starts combat attempts before resolving them and settles in the second.
clauses.backend: work/backend_i9_10/internal/application/eventcentre/service.go:268-281 (lockPlan); service.go:283-376 (Command); service.go:347-368 (Command txn); eventcentre/board.go:312-357 and 382-420 (1083 two transactions); migrations/00138_i9_10a_event_centre.sql:2-3
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for rejected/unqualified/stale/economy; 503 for unavailable
clauses.idempotency: command receipt is keyed by semantic operation UUID and checked before catalog validation; 1083 is resumable from the stored Attempt
clauses.concurrency: player root 315 serializes the same player; serializable retry covers write conflicts

clauses.title: 1072 GET_RECYCLE_INFO
clauses.rule: Reads the recycle building level and catalog energy limit, projects the stored energy anchor forward without writing, and appends building_info.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params; 503 when content unavailable
clauses.idempotency: pure read, no receipt

clauses.title: 1073 RECYCLE_ITEMS
clauses.rule: Settles recycle energy, computes ceil(resolve_energy*(1-cut_cost_energy))*item_num, refuses insufficient energy, debits the stacked item, applies the deterministic crit roll per resolved resource and grants the awards.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for invalid/foreign item, insufficient energy or unqualified catalog
clauses.idempotency: outer command receipt replays the exact stored body; test asserts the second send returns the same energy
clauses.concurrency: Serializable root txn; receipt insert conflicts abort
clauses.test: TestI910AWorkshopRecycleMakeAdminPetNative (awards, balances, replay, foreign item 409); internal/domain/eventcentre/types_test.go TestRecycleEnergyCostAndAwards

clauses.title: 1074 GET_DESKP_INFO
clauses.rule: Settles due make jobs, projects desk make state and building_info, with pet_id absent for the desk building.
clauses.client: app/model/EventCentre.lua:384-396; app/windows/ProductionTableWindow.lua:32-43,220-247 (building_info.lev/start_time/need_time/new_evolve, is_making, make_item, making_item, make_need_time, make_start_time)
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params; 503 when content unavailable
clauses.idempotency: read projection; due make settlement is a clone-only projection and writes nothing

clauses.title: 1075 MAKE_ITEM
clauses.rule: Requires an existing building at level >=1 with no job/pending item, a craftable item at the level, debits the recipe and starts a desk job pinned to the content revision.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for missing building/job/craftability or insufficient materials
clauses.idempotency: receipt keyed by operation; a fresh operation while a job exists refuses
clauses.concurrency: Serializable root txn; one active job per building section

clauses.title: 1076 CANCEL_MAKE_ITEM
clauses.rule: Refuses when no job or no time remains, refunds the floor of each cost line by remaining/duration and clears the job; the refund vector is returned in make_res_type/make_res_num.
clauses.reply: {is_making:0, make_item:0, making_item:0, make_need_time:0, make_start_time:0, make_res_type:[int], make_res_num:[int], building_info:{...}}
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 when there is no cancellable job or the building type is not desk/pet room
clauses.idempotency: receipt replays the exact body; a second distinct cancel refuses

clauses.title: 1081 GET_ADMIN_INFO
clauses.rule: Projects the day's per ordered source/destination conversion counts, zeroing pairs whose source is not unlocked at the admin building level; reset is game day 05:00 GMT+8.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params; 503 when content unavailable
clauses.idempotency: read projection; no write

clauses.title: 1082 ADMIN_CONVERSION
clauses.rule: Requires an admin building at level >=1 with no job, a source unlocked at that level, a pair count under 60, a catalog rule for the next ordinal, then debits the source and grants the destination; the pair counter increments.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for locked source, exhausted pair or invalid types
clauses.idempotency: receipt replays exact empty body; a fresh repeat debits again
clauses.concurrency: Serializable root txn; counter is per root

clauses.title: 1083 GET_NOTICE_BOARD_INFO (offers and settlement)
clauses.rule: Materializes the day's offers from owned-hero mission rows at the board level/player tier, then settles every stored mission whose start plus table duration has elapsed: start a server-report combat attempt in transaction one, resolve outside, grant/refund and save in transaction two. The reply is the four notice-board lists.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params; 503 on unavailable content or an unresolved attempt
clauses.idempotency: repeated 1083 is a read after settlement; report ids are monotonic and the second transaction restores the same history
clauses.concurrency: Two serializable transactions; stored Attempt prevents a second start for the same due mission
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (offers, loss settlement, replay, win settlement, 1086 clear); GAP: resolver-permanent close path board.go:367-380,492-501 is untested

clauses.title: 1084 RECEIVE_MISSION
clauses.rule: Requires an offered, not-doing mission known to the catalog with a tier and power cap; leader plus at most five partners must be owned, distinct and not busy; team displayed force must not exceed the tier upper_limit_fighting; deposit and blessing-crystal costs are debited, then the doing row is appended.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for not-offered/doing/missing tier, unowned/duplicate/busy hero, force over cap, bad partner count or insufficient cost
clauses.idempotency: same operation replays the stored receipt body and appends no second mission (tested)
clauses.concurrency: Serializable root txn; busy-hero check reads the locked root
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (1084 receive, replay one mission, busy hero 409, wish crystal debit)

clauses.title: 1085 GIVE_UP_MISSION
clauses.rule: Finds a doing mission, refunds the exact source deposit when it is a deposit task, removes the doing row and returns the mission id.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 when the mission is not doing or the mission row is missing
clauses.idempotency: receipt replay; a distinct second give-up refuses
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (1085 frees heroes); GAP: deposit-task give-up/refund is not exercised

clauses.title: 1086 CONFIRM_NEW_AWARD_LOG
clauses.rule: Clears the award log and returns an empty award_log list.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params
clauses.idempotency: receipt replay; repeating clears an already empty log

clauses.title: 1087 GET_NOTICE_BOARD_REPORT
clauses.rule: Reads one owned stored report id and returns it as report[1].content; the client JSON-decodes that string.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for missing battle_id or a report not owned by the actor
clauses.idempotency: pure read; no receipt
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (1087 loss and win reports decode to fighter/star)

clauses.title: 1088 CONFIRM_MAKE_ITEM
clauses.rule: Requires a settled pending item, grants one made item as a stack item and clears pending state.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 when a job is still active or there is no pending item
clauses.idempotency: receipt replay; a distinct second confirm without pending state refuses (tested)
clauses.test: TestI910AWorkshopRecycleMakeAdminPetNative (1088 desk and pet confirm, extra confirm 409)

clauses.title: 1089 ACCELERATE_MAKE_ITEM
clauses.rule: Requires an active job with time remaining and 1..ceil(remaining/accelerate_seconds) speed items, debits them and shifts the job start forward without passing the decision time; settled jobs project as pending items.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for inactive job, non-positive/over-max speed or insufficient items
clauses.idempotency: receipt replay; a fresh repeat debits again
clauses.test: TestI910AWorkshopRecycleMakeAdminPetNative (1089 desk and pet acceleration complete the job)

clauses.title: 1090 GET_PET_ROOM_INFO
clauses.rule: Projects the pet-room make state including pet_id and building_info; pet_id defaults to 0 when no pet is selected.
clauses.reply: {pet_id:int, is_making:int, make_item:int, making_item:int, make_need_time:int, make_start_time:int, building_info:{...}}
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on extra params; 503 when content unavailable
clauses.idempotency: read projection; due job settlement writes nothing

clauses.title: 1091 MAKE_PET_ITEM
clauses.rule: Requires a pet-room building, a real owned pet with a colour, a craftable item for that pet table at the level, debits the recipe and starts a pet-room job with pet_id.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for missing building/pet/craftability or insufficient materials
clauses.idempotency: receipt replay; a fresh operation while a job exists refuses

clauses.title: D509 extension building materialization
clauses.rule: Building types 2/5/6/7 materialize at level 1 only inside a validated Start plan and only for a registered content revision; a failed plan leaves no row and no write.
clauses.client: no client reply (building list is carried through existing book MIDs, e.g. 1056)
clauses.refusal: book-level invalid/unqualified refusal, surfaced by the existing Book dispatcher
clauses.idempotency: operation receipt inherited from the Book command path

clauses.title: Notice-board refresh and offer selection
clauses.rule: Offers are built from mission rows whose required hero is owned, at the player's tier minimum (1/10/20), sorted by mission id, rotated deterministically by player/day, capped by the board level task_limit; the first gold_task rows by deposit become deposit tasks.
clauses.refusal: no offer row refuses a start
clauses.idempotency: the offer set is stable for a player/day; RefreshDay gates regeneration
clauses.concurrency: offers are recomputed under the root lock; doing missions are excluded

clauses.title: Notice-board award and settlement
clauses.rule: The award is chosen deterministically by player/day/mission from the tier grade (deposit tasks use grade 2); a win grants item/material/gold lines and consumes the deposit, a loss grants nothing and refunds the deposit; wish doubles every award line; the report is stored and the history appended.
clauses.reply: finish_mission_list and award_log rows in the 1083 body
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on a missing award/mission row; 503 if combat produces no report
clauses.idempotency: settlement removes the doing row so a repeat 1083 does not resettle
clauses.concurrency: settlement shares the second serializable transaction with the history/report write
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (loss no award, win mana +500000, replay no second report); internal/domain/eventcentre/board_test.go TestWinAwardWishDoublesEveryLine; GAP: deposit-task loss refund and wish-crystal win doubling are not exercised through the native path

clauses.title: Notice-board eligibility and combat
clauses.rule: Leader/partners must be owned, same-server, distinct and not busy; displayed force sum must not exceed the tier cap; the fight is a SERVER_REPORT campaign_type 96 encounter with the mission enemy table ids as TEMPLATE actors.
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 for unowned/duplicate/busy hero or force over cap
clauses.idempotency: one attempt UUID per stored mission
clauses.concurrency: attempt start is under the root lock and stored before resolve
clauses.test: TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (busy hero, power loss/win, server report); the TEMPLATE stat limitation is recorded in UNKNOWN, not a missing test

clauses.title: Idempotency and receipts
clauses.rule: Mutations use a foundation receipt keyed by owner player, domain event-centre, family and operation UUID; the exact stored result payload is revalidated and replayed before fresh catalog reads. A different command on the same operation is ErrProof.
clauses.reply: replayed body is byte-identical to the stored result payload
clauses.refusal: 409 error_code 1 on proof mismatch; 503 on an indefinite outcome
clauses.idempotency: covered by C22
clauses.concurrency: receipt PutTx Inserted=false aborts with ErrProof
clauses.test: TestI910AWorkshopRecycleMakeAdminPetNative (1073 replay); TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (1084 replay); internal/domain tests cover proof helpers

clauses.title: Reply and refusal transport
clauses.rule: Success is HTTP 200 with the source-shaped body; business refusals are HTTP 409 with error_code; unavailable is 503; Event Centre malformed params also refuse 409/error_code 1 because callbacks index nested tables.
clauses.client: app/common/network/Backend handling: any 200 is OK; callbacks index nested reply tables (e.g. BoardMainWindow.lua:240-246)
clauses.refusal: 409 {error_code:N}; 503 {error_code:1}
clauses.idempotency: n/a
clauses.test: TestI910AWorkshopRecycleMakeAdminPetNative (foreign item 409/error_code 1, locked source 409, extra confirm 409); TestI910ANoticeBoardNative (busy 409)

clauses.title: Bounded scans and no foreign-owner SQL
clauses.rule: Every list is bounded and scoped to the logical server/player; the event-centre owner does not query i5/hero/combat tables directly.
clauses.refusal: unqualified facts -> 409 or 503
clauses.idempotency: n/a

clauses.title: D476 operator tunables
clauses.rule: The source/policy values in docs/i9/I9_10A_NOTICEBOARD_POLICY.json are recorded as the tunable surface; D476 requires a validated overlay and no endpoint before I11. No overlay table, endpoint or client price-refresh protocol is delivered in this leaf.
clauses.client: no client reply (no operator surface in the stock client)
clauses.refusal: n/a
clauses.idempotency: n/a
clauses.test: GAP: no validated Event Centre overlay test; carried to I11 operator tunables

I9_10A_NOTICE_BOARD_V1 named laws in internal/domain/eventcentre/board.go:13-39: refresh 05:00 GMT+8, owned-hero offer selection, tier grade award, deposit grade 2, wish doubles every line, win consumes/loss refunds deposit, displayed-force cap, server-report settlement, no offer refuses start, history 50, award log until confirm
Offer rotation by player/day is an implementation choice not stated in the policy JSON; awards are chosen deterministically by player/day/mission, not by an original-server entropy formula
Award log is capped at 11 and doing/offers at 11 as root-validity bounds; history is capped at 50 per the policy record
Event Centre malformed params use 409/error_code 1 rather than 400 so the stock success callback never receives a nested-shape error
Combat uses TEMPLATE actors; the resolver's table-shaped TEMPLATE cannot carry monster_star/monster_quality/monster_level, a known reconstruction limit
No D476 overlay table or operator endpoint ships before I11; the policy JSON is the source record, not an operator control
